policy: Actual engine, 150ms visible-state pilot; genuine routes and rewards. Paired seeds with/without key purchases may take different routes. Reward-window probes clone a naturally reached room-30 build and grant exactly one square only to the treatment; these isolate its following 15-room benefit, not human completion probability.

windowSummary.method: Paired natural room-30 checkpoints; one extra square only in treatment, then 15 rooms. Three chapter battles in this window have one stage. Subtract their fixed wave opening from room duration to compare chapter combat, not waiting for waves.
